bestFor: Engineering teams that want Playwright tests written and maintained for them
description: Checksum's agents generate Playwright tests, run them in your CI and propose fixes for broken tests as pull requests, with final checks by a human engineer. Pricing is quote-only and set by the number of workflows maintained, starting with a 50-workflow Emerging plan and a 30-day free trial.
pros: Tests are delivered as standard Playwright code that you own
Priced by workflows maintained, with no per-seat or per-run fees
30-day free trial on every plan
Dedicated solutions engineer on Slack from the first plan
cons: No published prices
API testing agent is Enterprise only
Native mobile testing is not mentioned

plans.name: Emerging
plans.notes: Quote-based; 50 maintained E2E workflows (a workflow is a test of up to 30 actions)

plans.name: Scaling
plans.notes: Quote-based; 200 workflows, parallel execution, custom style guides

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-based; 400+ workflows, API testing agent, custom SLA and security review

integrations: Playwright, your CI pipeline, GitHub pull requests

name: KaneAI
tagline: AI test agent from TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) that writes and runs web and mobile tests from natural-language instructions.
bestFor: Teams already using LambdaTest/TestMu AI device and browser clouds
description: KaneAI turns natural-language steps, Jira tickets or documents into tests for web and mobile apps, updates steps when the UI changes and exports code to Selenium, Playwright and Appium. Plans are priced per agent, starting at $17 a month billed annually ($19 billed monthly).
pros: Entry plan $17/month per agent billed annually
Exports tests to Selenium, Playwright and Appium code
Kane CLI runs headless in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI and Jenkins
14-day free trial and monthly billing available
cons: Priced per agent, and credits run out: Starter's 2,000 credits are about 25 tests of 40 steps
Cloud authoring needs Pro ($89/month annual); mobile authoring needs Max ($179/month annual)
All fees are non-refundable

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Per agent per month (each agent includes 1 Test Manager seat); 2,000 credits/month; local authoring via Kane CLI

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per agent per month; 12,000 credits/month; cloud web authoring; 100 HyperExecute minutes/month

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: Per agent per month; 25,000 credits/month; cloud web and mobile authoring; 300 HyperExecute minutes/month

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited credits, custom seats and concurrency, SSO, 24x7 support

integrations: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Jira, GitHub pull requests, TestMu AI HyperExecute and real device cloud

name: Autify Aximo
tagline: AI testing agent that runs end-to-end tests from plain-English scenarios on web, mobile and desktop apps without scripts or selectors.
bestFor: Teams that want scenario-based AI testing across web and mobile
description: Aximo takes a test scenario written in plain English and navigates the app like a user to check the expected outcome, without scripts or selectors. A free Individual plan includes 2,000 one-time credits, and the Core plan is $99 a month billed annually or $120 monthly.
pros: Free Individual plan with 2,000 credits that do not expire
Published prices: Core $99/month annual, Team $450/month annual
Web and mobile testing on all plans, including the free plan
Autify lists SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022
cons: Desktop app testing and on-premises hosting are Enterprise only
Credits are used per AI step, and larger models and mobile runs use more
Add-on credits are not available on the free plan
freePlanDetails: Individual User plan: 2,000 one-time credits with no expiration, 1 web and 1 mobile concurrent run

name: Testsigma
tagline: Test automation platform with plain-English tests and AI agents for web, mobile, API, Salesforce and SAP.
bestFor: Enterprise QA teams covering web, mobile, API and Salesforce in one tool
description: Testsigma's AI coworker Atto generates plain-English tests from user stories, Jira or Figma, runs them and heals broken locators. Pro and Enterprise plans are quote-only, priced on expected usage.
pros: Plain-English test steps across web, native mobile, API, Salesforce and SAP
Unlimited applications, projects and automated testing minutes on Pro
2,000+ real mobile devices and 800+ browser/OS combinations on Pro
On-premises or private cloud deployment on Enterprise
cons: No published prices
AI test case generation and SAML SSO are listed under Enterprise
Free trial length is not stated

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; adds SAML SSO, on-prem or private cloud, AI test case generation, high-priority support

name: Reflect
tagline: No-code test tool from SmartBear that turns plain-English steps into web, mobile and API tests.
bestFor: Teams that want no-code tests with unlimited users
description: Reflect, owned by SmartBear since January 2024, lets testers write steps in plain English and runs web, real-device mobile and API tests without relying on fixed selectors. Plans are credit-based and quote-only, with a 14-day free trial.
pros: Unlimited users and unlimited test creation on every plan
Clear credit rates: web test 1 credit, mobile test 5, API test 0.1
Mobile tests run on real devices, not emulators
Integrates with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure DevOps and Bitbucket
cons: No published prices
Mobile parallel testing is an add-on on every plan
Private-environment testing (Reflect Tunnel) is Enterprise only
